sampling: First 1000 complete records in bounded public machine-table prefix; not random.
objective: Check whether ECG machine summary text produces any lab/echo/demographic proposals or auto-confirmation. No diagnostic label mapping or CAD scoring. Negative-only corpus cannot establish extraction sensitivity or clinical safety.
scope: Development regression of the unchanged 1000 MIMIC machine reports after echo-template parser safeguards; original evaluation preserved. Not independent validation.
